name: arangodb
description: arangodb — ArangoDB multi-model database CLI. Query graph, document, and key-value data with AQL.

install_steps: curl -LO https://download.arangodb.com/arangodb3/Community/Linux/arangodb3-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf arangodb3-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv arangosh /usr/local/bin/ && rm -rf arangodb3*
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or package manager.
